text:
Maria: quick sync — release cutoff is TOMORROW 3pm PT. need final owners for changelog, sampleapps, and the SDK packaging step. can we confirm who is on point? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Kevin: I can own the changelog this cycle. will collect PR notes by EOD today.
Ash: sampleapps packaging mostly done, but e2e is failing on the auth mock. CI log below — blocking the sampleapp tarball publish:
```
ERROR: Failed to start mock-auth: address already in use
stack: net.Listen tcp 0.0.0.0:8081: bind: address already in use
```
Jules: looks like the local runner isn't tearing down ports in the matrix job. I can add a teardown step, will send a quick PR (#4127).
Sam: SDK packaging needs a tiny shim for the new dist tag. I'll create the release branch and cut artifacts once changelog is final. cc @Kevin
Maria: thanks. @Jules please target the PR against ci-config before midnight so we can run another matrix tomorrow morning. if teardown fixes it, we should be green.
linda-ci: deploy-bot triggered: sampleapps/e2e pipeline failed 2h ago (job sampleapp-linux).
Kevin: quick Q — are we including the runtime-compat note in the changelog or separate docs? open to either but prefer changelog short + docs deep-dive link.
Maria: changelog short + pointer to docs. Kevin please add a one-paragraph runtime-compat note and link to docs PR.
Ash: fyi the auth mock failure only happens when parallel matrix runs hit the same port. I can randomize the port if teardown PR doesn't land in time. which is faster?
Jules: teardown PR should be trivial, but randomizing port is even quicker. I'll land the teardown for hygiene; Ash, if you can randomize now that buys us runway.
Sam: also hitting a minor packaging gotcha — node-scripts expect an env var QUICKSTART_BASE, which docs call QUICKSTART_URL. we should normalize before we ship to avoid users hitting 404.
Maria: agree, normalize to QUICKSTART_URL and add a migration note in the changelog. Kevin add a bullet.
Kevin: added bullet, pushed draft changelog to the docs repo under /changelogs/draft-1729.md. feedback welcome.
Ash: merged random-port tweak to sampleapp runner (CI job retriggered).
deploy-bot: CI pipeline retriggered for sampleapps/e2e.
Jules: teardown step merged to ci-config, will flip on in a follow-up to avoid config churn.
Maria: current action items:
- Kevin: finalize changelog + add migration bullet (owner)
- Ash: confirm e2e green + publish sampleapp tarball if CI passes (owner)
- Sam: branch + cut SDK artifacts after changelog final (owner)
- Jules: monitor CI teardown and follow-up cleanup (owner)
If we hit any blockers by 11am PT tomorrow we escalate to release oncall. otherwise we proceed with cutoff at 3pm PT.
Sam: noted, I'll hold off cutting artifacts until I see the changelog merge.
Kevin: will merge changelog once I get final LGTM from docs (pinging @Maria for quick review).
Maria: LGTM on the changelog draft, small nit fixed inline.
Ash: sampleapp e2e passed on the retrigger. publishing tarball now.
Sam: artifact upload done. tagging release-candidate/v1.4.0-rc1.
Kevin: changelog merged and released. putting a short note in #announcements when cut is complete.
Maria: big thanks everyone. post-cutoff: please add any follow-ups to the release board with labels "post-cutoff" and "devexp". :tada:
